# Flurry — G4 background mare

Flurry is the *unnamed Earth-pony mare* seen among the ancient Earth tribe in the Hearth’s Warming pageant—not Princess Flurry Heart. Recognize her by her **gray-lavender coat, pale golden-yellow mane and tail, and blue-violet eyes**. “Flurry” is a **fan-wiki placeholder name**, not a verified spoken, credited, or merchandise name. The [G4 Earth-pony catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies) identifies her appearances; the similarly named [Flurry Heart](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Flurry_Heart?page=5) is a separate alicorn foal.

**Speaking:** No verified individual lines or voice actor. **Appearances:** *Hearth’s Warming Eve* (S2E11, 2011), in the opening play, Earth-pony home, and three-tribe summit; a brief historical flashback in *Shadow Play – Part 2* (S7E26, 2017), available on [ABC iview](https://iview.abc.net.au/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/series/7/video/ZW4155A026S00). No confirmed alter ego or separate named role. The older [G1 toy named Flurry](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Flurry) belongs to a different generation.

## Important moments

1. **Life in the Earth-pony home — *Hearth’s Warming Eve* (S2E11).** Flurry appears amid the ordinary Earth ponies whose survival is threatened by the worsening winter; she is background context rather than a decision-maker.
